item.title: Taking Mario Kart 64 to Silverstone
item.description: I built Silverstone as a Mario Kart 64 course with GPT 6.1 Sol in Codex cloud environments, then used Max Verstappen’s pole lap onboard to shape the scenery, corner by corner.
